Poste basé à Angers, à pourvoir rapidement.

review_candidates.description: Overview Be trusted to make great things happen. You might know us for the great work we do across our wide variety of projects. We're proud to say it's thanks to our people's diversity of thought, expertise and knowledge. The team is responsible for delivery of design services across our markets of Rail and Transit, Highways and Local Transport, and lean out into other sectors including Defence and Nuclear. We have a wide client base including HS2, National Highways, Network Rail, Irish Rail, Local Authorities, as well as several Principal Contractors. This is an exciting opportunity within the PDP Rail and Transit team for an experienced Senior Project Manager looking to lead the successful delivery of our projects, influence the growth and development of the project management team and progress into a Project Director role. With a home office in Manchester, Birmingham, Derby or Stockton-on-Tees, this role requires flexibility to travel two to three days per week across the UK and Ireland to be involved in some of our most exciting flagship projects. Your role Project Delivery and Team Leadership Lead major rail projects as a Senior Project Manager, or smaller rail projects as a Project Director. Make sure projects meet revenue, profit and cash-flow targets, with clear reporting. Lead multi-disciplinary teams, including Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers and Design Managers. Plan resources with resource managers to make sure projects are properly supported. Keep teams aligned on scope, programme, cost, risk, constraints and interfaces. Governance and Commercial Management Make sure projects meet client, governance, technical, HSE and quality requirements. Manage project delivery and contract administration through the full project life cycle. Team Development and Community Contribution Share best practice and lessons learned across the project management community. Support and mentor Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers and other team members. Client and Business Growth Build strong client relationships to support successful rail project delivery and win repeat work. Support Regional Client Directors in shaping and delivering the regional rail strategy. Lead bids for rail opportunities, with a strong focus on deliverable and well-planned solutions. Project/Engineering Management background with experience of the Heavy Rail or Light Rail/Mass Transit sector gained delivering work for clients such as Network Rail, HS2, Transport for London, Transport for Greater Manchester and Principal Contractors. Good understanding of design procedures, change control, checking and review requirements. Professional membership and recognised level of Project Management competence (eg. MAPM, MICE, PMQ, ChPP, or equivalent) – desirable. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life. Be rewarded. Find out more. review_candidates.title: Senior Financial Analyst
review_candidates.description: Senior Financial Analyst EV Charging Infrastructure | Investor, Owner & Operator Location: Remote (U.S.), with occasional travel for periodic company offsites Reports To: Chief Financial Officer ABOUT OUR CLIENT Talisman Advisory Partners is delighted to be partnering with a growth-stage EV charging infrastructure investor, owner, and operator that is building the charging infrastructure needed for the future of real estate. Our client partners with multifamily owners, operators, hotels, and other real estate organizations to deploy and operate Level 2 EV charging solutions, eliminating the upfront capital costs and ongoing operational and technology burdens traditionally associated with EV charging. The business is backed by a leading institutional sustainable infrastructure investor and is scaling its national portfolio. THE ROLE Our client is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as the central owner of the company’s underwriting model, corporate financial model, and Investment Committee (IC) materials. This is a blended role: you will run day-to-day underwriting and deal analysis for the Go-To-Market (GTM) team, own the analytical and reporting infrastructure that supports every deal decision, and provide senior-level judgment on model integrity, assumptions, and IC-ready outputs. You will also partner with the Strategy/Data team to track operational performance against underwriting assumptions, support insurance matters, and act as a point of quality and guidance for junior analytical support. This role is a great fit for someone who wants to sit at the center of how the company evaluates, finances, and communicates its deals, with real ownership from day one. WHAT YOU'LL DO Underwriting & Corporate Financial Model ▪ Model Ownership: Run and maintain the corporate financial model, ensuring it reflects current assumptions, deal structures, and business logic. ▪ Underwriting: Lead day-to-day underwriting for new prospective deals, sizing economics and flagging key risks and sensitivities for the GTM team. ▪ Customer-Facing Materials: Build clear, compelling proposals, pro formas, and deal summaries that GTM can bring directly to prospects and partners. ▪ IC Materials: Own the end-to-end IC materials process, packaging underwriting outputs, key assumptions, and risks into a clear investment narrative for a senior audience. ▪ IC Support: Serve as a primary point of contact for IC-related questions and follow-ups on deal economics. Operational Tracking, Model Refresh & Collaboration ▪ Actual-to-UW Tracking: Work with the Strategy/Data team to track how live sites and portfolios are performing against original underwriting assumptions. ▪ Model Refresh: Use actual operating data (utilization, revenue per session, opex/capex) to periodically update and recalibrate model assumptions and drivers. ▪ Data Analysis: Pull, clean, and analyze operational data from the charging network, deployment partners, and internal systems to support both deal analysis and model updates. ▪ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with GTM, Strategy/Data, Operations, and Finance to keep deal analysis, IC materials, and the financial model consistent and current. ▪ Ad Hoc Analysis: Support the Finance team on special projects (M&A, fundraising, FP&A) and other analytical requests as they arise. REQUIRED SKILLS ▪ 3+ years of experience in financial analysis, investment/underwriting analysis, corporate finance, or a related analytical role. ▪ Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, deal analysis, and scenario/sensitivity analysis. ▪ Demonstrated ownership of a financial or underwriting model, including maintaining and evolving it over time. ▪ Experience building materials for external or senior-audience consumption (e.g. customer-facing proposals, Investment Committee memos, board decks). ▪ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational data into clear financial takeaways. ▪ Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working independently in a build-mode environment. ▪ Strong communication skills; able to work cross-functionally with GTM, Strategy/Data, Investments, and Finance. ▪ Ability to work remotely within the United States with reliable internet access, and to maintain the confidentiality of financial information. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE ▪ Experience owning or building underwriting models in infrastructure, EV, real estate, or other capital-intensive or investment settings. ▪ Experience supporting or presenting to an Investment Committee or similar deal-approval process. ▪ Familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar data analysis and visualization tools. ▪ Experience tying operational and data-source metrics back to financial or investment models. ▪ Exposure to corporate insurance programs or risk management. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS ▪ Base Salary: $120,000 to $150,000 (U.S. remote). ▪ Bonus: Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, with target payout commensurate with role and experience. ▪ Equity: Eligible for a long-term incentive program. ▪ Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision; 401(k) with company match; 20 days of paid time off plus company holidays. WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY EV adoption is creating significant infrastructure opportunity for real estate owners across the country. Our client’s model removes the financial, operational, and technological barriers that have traditionally made EV charging difficult for property owners. The company is building a national platform in a rapidly developing market, and the analysis this role produces directly shapes which deals it pursues and how they are communicated. The successful candidate will have direct visibility into that commercial impact and will help decision making. This is an exciting opportunity to join a team delivering a high-impact solution for EV infrastructure and to help shape the future of sustainable transportation and mobility. HOW TO APPLY This search is being managed by Talisman Advisory Partners. To be considered, please submit your resume to the Talisman team via link the below or alternatively, email kaeli.long@talismanap.com with the subject line “Senior Financial Analyst, EV Infrastructure: [Your Name]”. All applications and enquiries will be handled in strict confidence

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Director, Commercial Clinical Next-Generation Sequencing based in Germany. We are seeking an accomplished commercial leader to drive strategic growth and business performance across the EMEA clinical next-generation sequencing (NGS) market. In this senior leadership role, you will shape regional sales strategies, establish profitability objectives and lead initiatives that strengthen market share and customer relationships. You will oversee commercial operations across clinical oncology, translational research and applied clinical markets, translating industry insights into sustainable business opportunities. Working closely with cross-functional and international teams, you will build high-performing sales organizations and develop strong partnerships with key customers, distributors and industry opinion leaders. You will also establish robust forecasting, pricing and commercial excellence processes to ensure predictable growth and operational efficiency. This fully remote opportunity offers significant regional influence, with international travel required to support customers, teams and strategic business priorities. Accountabilities Develop regional commercial strategy: Define and implement the EMEA commercial roadmap for clinical NGS, including sales positioning, go-to-market strategies and initiatives aligned with revenue, profitability and market expansion objectives. Drive financial performance: Take ownership of revenue, margin, customer satisfaction and market share targets, consistently meeting or exceeding sales and profitability plans. Establish commercial excellence: Build and optimize sales operating mechanisms, including forecasting, pipeline and funnel management, business intelligence, sales training and marketing processes to improve performance and predictability. Build strategic customer relationships: Develop long-term partnerships with key healthcare customers, C-level stakeholders, clinical experts, key opinion leaders and industry influencers to strengthen customer engagement and accelerate adoption. Lead cross-functional collaboration: Partner with regional and global leadership, product management, medical affairs, marketing, finance, customer care, field application specialists, services and supply chain teams to align priorities and support commercial execution. Expand market opportunities: Analyze industry developments, competitive dynamics and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities across clinical oncology, translational research and applied clinical markets. Manage commercial performance: Lead regular business reviews, monitor sales forecasts and market trends, communicate competitive intelligence and coordinate actions needed to achieve sustained year-over-year growth. Oversee pricing and promotional strategies: Establish pricing guidelines, improve pricing visibility and develop product bundling, promotional and discounting strategies that support competitiveness and profitability. Strengthen distributor partnerships: Develop relationships with distribution partners, particularly in emerging markets, and implement strategies to capture additional regional growth opportunities. Lead and develop commercial teams: Recruit, coach, mentor and retain high-performing talent, establishing clear accountability, ownership and consistent best practices across a geographically dispersed organization.
